name: padding does not change loss
test:
import torch
base_logits = torch.tensor([[[3., 0., 0.], [0., 3., 0.]]])
base_targets = torch.tensor([[0, 1]])
extra_logits = torch.cat([base_logits, torch.tensor([[[100., -100., 0.]]])], dim=1)
extra_targets = torch.tensor([[0, 1, 2]])
a = masked_cross_entropy(base_logits, base_targets, 2)
b = masked_cross_entropy(extra_logits, extra_targets, 2)
assert torch.allclose(a, b, atol=1e-6)

name: masked cross entropy has the correct non-pad mean and gradients
test:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
logits = torch.tensor([[[1000., 999., -500.], [2., -1., 3.], [-900., -800., 1000.]], [[-3., 2., 0.], [4., 3., 2.], [100., -100., 0.]]], dtype=torch.float64, requires_grad=True)
targets = torch.tensor([[0, 1, 2], [1, 0, 2]])
actual = masked_cross_entropy(logits, targets, 2)
reference = F.cross_entropy(logits.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True).reshape(-1, 3), targets.reshape(-1), ignore_index=2)
assert actual.ndim == 0 and torch.isfinite(actual)
assert torch.allclose(actual, reference, atol=1e-10)
actual.backward()
assert logits.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(logits.grad).all()
assert torch.equal(logits.grad[targets == 2], torch.zeros_like(logits.grad[targets == 2]))
assert bool(logits.grad[targets != 2].abs().sum() > 0)

name: greedy decoding waits for all rows and runs without gradients
test:
import torch
from torch import nn
class DecodeOracle(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.calls = 0
    def forward(self, source, decoded):
        assert not torch.is_grad_enabled(), 'decoding must disable autograd'
        self.calls += 1
        token = torch.tensor([2, 3] if decoded.shape[1] == 1 else [7, 2], device=source.device)
        logits = torch.full((2, decoded.shape[1], 9), -10.0, device=source.device)
        logits[:, -1].scatter_(1, token[:, None], 10.0)
        return logits
source = torch.tensor([[4, 5], [6, 7]])
model = DecodeOracle()
actual = greedy_decode(model, source, 1, 2, 5)
assert torch.equal(actual, torch.tensor([[1, 2, 2], [1, 3, 2]]))
assert model.calls == 2
no_stop = DecodeOracle()
assert greedy_decode(no_stop, source, 1, None, 3).shape == (2, 4)
assert no_stop.calls == 3
empty = DecodeOracle()
assert torch.equal(greedy_decode(empty, source, 1, 2, 0), torch.ones(2, 1, dtype=torch.long))
assert empty.calls == 0
